dedupe_keys.name: global coastal wind hazard maps from the chaz tropical cyclone model

description: Global coastal wind hazard maps from the CHAZ tropical cyclone model is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Simona Meiler et al. Synthetic tropical cyclone (TC) models have become essential tools for assessing TC hazard and risk, due to both the shortness of observational records and, now, the influence of climate change. However, the direct output from these models, TC track sets, requires additional processing to become useful for impact assessments beyond traditional climate science and meteorological research. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, NetCDF, Raster. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 58449103469 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
